description: Boundary policy for a supplement education assistant. It constrains topic drift; it does not provide medical advice.

rules.pattern: \b(chest pain|trouble breathing|can'?t breathe|cannot breathe|faint(?:ed|ing)?|severe allergic reaction|throat closing|tongue swelling)\b
rules.reason: The prompt includes emergency or potentially urgent symptom language.

rules.assumption: User is not asking to change prescribed medication
rules.reason: The prompt asks to stop, replace, or change prescribed medication with supplement guidance.

rules.pattern: \b(diagnose|treat|cure|treatment plan|protocol for|what disease|cancer protocol|reverse my|heal my)\b
rules.assumption: Prompt is not asking for diagnosis or disease treatment
rules.reason: The prompt asks the supplement coach to act like a diagnosis or treatment system.
The prompt asks about supplements with medication, so the answer must stay general and route to clinician or pharmacist review.

rules.assumption: Pregnancy or breastfeeding context is absent
rules.reason: Pregnancy or breastfeeding changes the response boundary for supplement guidance.

rules.pattern: \b(what dose|how much should i take|how many milligrams|mg should i take|personal dose|dose for me)\b
rules.assumption: Prompt is not asking for personalized dosing
rules.reason: The prompt asks for personalized dosing rather than general supplement education.

rules.pattern: \b(kidney disease|liver disease|heart disease|diabetes|blood thinner|high blood pressure|hypertension|cancer|seizure disorder)\b
rules.assumption: No high-risk health context is present
rules.reason: The prompt includes a health context that makes supplement guidance more sensitive.

prior_medication_context.assumption: No earlier medication context constrains this prompt
prior_medication_context.reason: Earlier conversation mentioned medication, so later supplement guidance must remain constrained.
